answer: An farming party running 178 aliases therefore needs 108 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in ferrous, expire in fable, and vertex lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3807 identities would post 4271 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
